Jonah Becker, Director of Design, introduces the Fitbit Edge, a durable tracker built for comfort and clear visibility. We designed it with a bright screen for easy reading in sunlight, a physical button for quick control during workouts, and a curved shape that fits your wrist naturally. It features a recycled aluminum body, water resistance, and a seven-day battery life. You can customize your look with a variety of new bands for any occasion.
When we set out to design the new Fitbit Edge , 1 we asked ourselves a fundamental question: How do we reimagine the fitness tracker to establish a bold new standard for performance, aesthetics, and comfort?
For millions of people, a lightweight, discreet tracker is the ideal health and fitness companion. But active lifestyles demand more than just passive tracking. They require at-a-glance readability, dependable durability, and all-day comfort. With Fitbit Edge, we reconsidered every curve, interaction, and material to create a wearable device that feels as natural during a strenuous workout as it does at a dinner party.
Our first major design focus was the screen. When you’re mid-stride during a run, you shouldn’t have to squint or break your rhythm to check your stats.
Our largest, brightest tracker display yet features a brilliant Hybrid OLED panel that’s easy to read, even with a harsh outdoor glare. 2 We paired the screen with a completely overhauled UX and UI, structuring information into glanceable, high-contrast tiles and expressive clock faces that spotlight your key health and fitness information while delivering a distinctive look that elevates Fitbit Edge’s unique form.
We carefully designed the mechanical architecture to include a tactile physical side button. A responsive touchscreen is great for daily navigation, but when you're mid-workout, tactility is everything. Sweaty fingers or wet weather can make on-screen tapping frustrating, but the ergonomic side button ensures that pausing your workout — or taking any other quick actions — is just a click away.
To ensure Fitbit Edge fits well, we sculpted the thin chassis and bottom sensor housing with a subtle curve. By contouring the device to match the anatomy of your wrist, we minimized pressure points while ensuring continuous skin contact for 24/7 heart-rate and sleep tracking.
Water- and dust-resistant, 3 Fitbit Edge balances elegance with active durability. Its chassis is made from 100% recycled aluminum 4 and comes in four finishes: Obsidian, Olive, Canyon, and Fog.
Our accessories have also been completely redesigned. 5 Switching up your look is easy whether you opt for a sleek, minimalist look or an active, athletic design.
Active Sport Band: Features wide perforations for maximum breathability during intense workouts. Available in Obsidian, Porcelain, Olive, and Hibiscus.
Performance Loop Band: 6 Combines stretchable, micro-adjustable fabric with custom swivel lugs to wrap closely to your wrist. Available in Obsidian, Fog, Olive, and Canyon.
Magnet Band : Pairs a premium silicone substrate with soft magnets for an intuitive clasp and a clean, minimalist silhouette. Available in Obsidian, Fog, and Mahogany.
Metal Link Band : Brings a classic, refined aesthetic to your daily companion. Available in Matte Black, Brushed Silver, and Champagne Gold.
When you're wearing a device 24/7, you need to trust that it's built to last . We thoughtfully crafted every detail of Fitbit Edge to stand up to your toughest days and keep up with your active lifestyle. With up to seven days of battery life, 7 it lets you spend less time plugged in and more time getting after your goals.
